steps.teacher_prompt: You want to buy an ice cream. What do you do first?
steps.scene_image_prompt: Hoovy the otter near an ice-cream shop counter with other kids in line, bright pastel street scene
steps.hint_on_wrong: We wait our turn in line.
steps.praise_on_correct: Yes! Waiting your turn is the kind thing to do.

steps.teacher_prompt: The clerk says the ice cream costs two dollars. What do you give?
steps.scene_image_prompt: Hoovy the otter holding out two one-dollar bills to a friendly shopkeeper, bright pastel shop counter
steps.hint_on_wrong: Ice cream costs two dollars. Hand the clerk two dollars.
steps.praise_on_correct: Perfect! That's exactly the right amount.

steps.teacher_prompt: You got your ice cream! What do you say to the clerk?
steps.scene_image_prompt: Hoovy the otter holding a strawberry ice cream cone with a happy smile, friendly shopkeeper smiling back
steps.hint_on_wrong: Say 'Thank you' when someone serves you.
